description: Unit tests for PoliciesModelFactory in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package, focusing on resource key creation and validation logic.

classes.name: PoliciesModelFactoryTest

methods.name: resourceKeysFromDifferentInstantiationsAreEqual
